name: queryHospitalConfiguration
shortDescription: Retrieves hospital-wide configuration details such as operating hours, holidays, and general policies for display in the UI.
description:
Overview

Fetches hospital-wide configuration details, including operating hours, holidays, and general policies. This information is typically read-only and displayed across various parts of the application.

Intended use

Called by any UI component (patient portal, doctor dashboard, admin dashboard) that needs to display general hospital information.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the singleton HospitalConfiguration record using ctx.data.get.
  2. Return the HospitalConfiguration data.

Entities

  • HospitalConfiguration
